title: Mirrors Here KEEP Your Reflection 🪞
description:
In this town, mirrors keep your reflection after you leave. The fry van's shiny side has a queue a hundred people long, and a puddle on the boards still has a man tying his boot from March.

It's the last night of the travelling fair, and Tasha meets me at the mirror maze, the way she has every night this week.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MIRROR if you knew who was talking.
